turns.speaker: N
turns.text: Hello, I am Leo. I am ten years old. I live in a city near the sea. I like noodles best. My father makes them for me on Fridays. At weekends, I often ride my bicycle in the park with my cousin. We stop to watch the ducks. This winter holiday, I will go to the science museum with my class. I want to see the big model plane there.
